summary: Phase 4 Slice 4.0 — Workflow Engine Foundation acceptance gate PASSED end-to-end. 51/51 tests green: 29 in-process binding tests (tests/test_phase4_slice40_workflow.py — definitions, instance state-machine, replay determinism, tasks, timers, PEP enforcement, projection), 8 contract freeze tests (tests/test_contract_freeze.py — contract pinned at v2.0.0, no drift, role matrix + event catalog + SDK fingerprints clean), and 14 new public-URL probes (tests/test_phase4_slice40_public_url.py) exercising every acceptance bullet in the review_request through https://evidence-trust.preview.emergentagent.com. Every workflow endpoint behaves per spec: unauth=401, plain-user start=403, super_admin start returns instance_id with business_state=received, echo.v1 generates a workflow_tasks row scoped to compliance_officer, suspend→reactivate moves lifecycle suspended→running, cancel sets lifecycle=cancelled, replay returns matches_committed=true (after the documented ~2.5s outbox publish window), replay denies plain users with 403, /api/v1/workflow/admin/timers/{nonexistent}/fire returns 404, POST /instances with nonexistent.v9 returns 404 workflow.definition.not_found, GET /api/v1/admin/projections lists BOTH evidence.timeline and the new workflow.instance projection, and /api/v1/admin/projections/workflow.instance reports delivered_count>=1. The schema field for the start payload is `payload` (not `input`) — verified against /app/backend/contexts/workflow/api/router.py StartWorkflowRequest. Pre-existing Phase 2A legacy failures (test_concurrency, test_tenant_isolation, test_worker_reports) were explicitly skipped per agent_to_agent_context_note (D-5 technical debt, NOT Phase 4-caused).
critical_code_review_comments: Replay endpoint depends on the outbox publisher having delivered the started event before /admin/instances/{id}/replay is called — the slice test wisely sleeps 2.5s, and the public-URL probe does too. For ops, suggest documenting this eventual-consistency window in the ADR-0023 acceptance notes or returning 425 Too Early (rather than 404 workflow.instance.not_found with 'has no events') when the instance exists but its events have not yet been published, to avoid operator confusion.

Pydantic 'extra_forbidden' on the start payload is good (constitutional strictness), but consider documenting that the field name is `payload` not `input` in the OpenAPI/SDK examples — an external integrator following common REST naming would naturally try `input` and get a 422.

Two pre-existing deprecation warnings (FastAPI @app.on_event startup/shutdown in main.py:186 and main.py:413) — pre-existing, not Slice 4.0 scope, but worth scheduling a migration to lifespan handlers.
